purpose: Assemble repaired DEV Batch 1-8 event rows and verify source traceability before event freeze. This gate may flag rows for review but may not delete, relabel, replace, pair, rebalance, or score them.
automatic_checks: HTTP request returns retrievable content when network permits
page text/title has subject-name token evidence OR source metadata page is structurally identifiable
page text has event year evidence when year is reasonably expected
page text has at least one event-type keyword family when applicable

classification.AUTO_PASS: URL fetched and minimum traceability signals satisfy frozen thresholds.
classification.MANUAL_REVIEW: URL inaccessible, dynamically rendered, or minimum traceability signals do not satisfy threshold.

next_rule: If any eligible row is MANUAL_REVIEW or INVALID_SOURCE_FIELD, do not freeze. Return the manual-review worklist for independent web verification. Only after all eligible rows have verified source support may the event corpus freeze.
